subject: Re: Redwood & StellarSys discovery — next steps and rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Saira Khan <saira.khan@stellarsys.com>, Kenji Tanaka <kenji.tanaka@stellar-sys.co.jp>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + StellarSys discovery — next steps (demo scheduling)

Hi Saira, Kenji — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we heard on the call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for interactive search and lower per-token cost for customer-facing flows.
- Key constraints: EU data residency, single-tenant isolation for sensitive workloads, and a likely need for predictable throughput during peak windows.

As discussed, next step is a technical deep-dive / demo with our SE to walk through: model variants, latency/cost tradeoffs, and a proposed routing strategy (hosted + dedicated fallbacks). We know coordinating across US/EU/APAC is a pain — to keep this simple we wanted to propose a rotating set of weekly slots so each discipline (product, infra, APAC ops) can join at least one convenient time over the next two weeks.

Proposed rotating 60-minute slot options (we can tighten to 30 if you prefer):
- Option A (EMEA-friendly): Tue 10:00–11:00 CET / Mon 01:00–02:00 PDT / Tue 18:00–19:00 JST
- Option B (Americas-friendly): Wed 09:00–10:00 PDT / Wed 17:00–18:00 CET / Thu 01:00–02:00 JST
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00–10:00 JST / Wed 16:00–17:00 PDT / Thu 01:00–02:00 CET

If you share which of these work for your team (and roughly who would join from each region), I’ll send calendar invites and include Marissa from our SE team for the technical portion. Attaching the discovery notes and a short requirements map I put together while we spoke.

Calendly link if easier to pick a time: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-technical-deep-dive

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, requirements-map.xlsx
From: Saira Khan <saira.khan@stellarsys.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kenji Tanaka <kenji.tanaka@stellar-sys.co.jp>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 23:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood + StellarSys discovery — next steps (demo scheduling)

Thanks Aditya — useful recap. We can cover the following folks on our side:
- Saira Khan (me) — Product / EU lead
- Tomas Müller — Infra (Berlin) — prefers EMEA windows
- Kenji Tanaka — APAC ops (Tokyo) — will likely join remotely for one of the APAC/EMEA-friendly slots

Initial availability: Option A looks best for Tomas and me (Tue 10:00 CET). Kenji is in Tokyo so the time should be OK occasionally but would prefer Option C if we need more APAC overlap.

Would prefer a 60-minute deep-dive for the first session so we can cover architecture and questions. If you can include Marissa from engineering that would be great.

Saira
Saira Khan | Head of Product, StellarSys
saira.khan@stellarsys.com

On Thu, Mar 5, 2026 at 16:15, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Saira, Kenji — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we heard on the call...
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Saira Khan <saira.khan@stellarsys.com>, Kenji Tanaka <kenji.tanaka@stellar-sys.co.jp>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 02:30:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + StellarSys discovery — next steps and rotating demo slots

Great — thanks Saira. Looping in Marissa (SE) so she can run the technical deep-dive.

Marissa — short context: StellarSys is evaluating a hybrid serving approach: hosted API for non-sensitive flows, dedicated capacity for EU-resident, high-throughput paths. They care about predictable latency and want to understand quantization/throughput tradeoffs for their search models.

Based on availability, I propose we lock the first session on Option A (Tue 10:00 CET) and then rotate the following week to Option C so Kenji and APAC can get a friendly slot. That gives everyone at least one session in-office hours for their region. Proposed schedule:
- Week 1: Option A — Tue 10:00–11:00 CET (60m) — architecture + initial demo (Marissa to lead)
- Week 2: Option C — Thu 09:00–10:00 JST (60m) — follow-up, deeper perf numbers, model variant Q&A

I attached the discovery notes and a one-sheet requirements map. If that plan works I’ll send invites for both sessions and include dial-in and a short agenda. Also included a Calendly link if you prefer to self-select an exact slot.

Marissa, can you confirm you can take the Week 1 demo (Tue 10:00 CET)?

Thanks —
Aditya

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, requirements-map.xlsx
From: Kenji Tanaka <kenji.tanaka@stellar-sys.co.jp>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Saira Khan <saira.khan@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:02:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + StellarSys discovery — next steps and rotating demo slots

Thanks — Option A for Week 1 is OK for me this time, though I may need to step out 30 minutes early depending on ops. Week 2 Option C (Thu 09:00 JST) is ideal for the APAC crew.

If it's helpful we can also make the Week 1 session 45m focused on high-level architecture and then use Week 2 for the deeper perf discussion so I can ensure the right engineers are present for Week 2.

Kenji
